_comment: A real 60-minute window of the Azure LLM Inference 2024 code trace, replayed
verbatim: no time compression, no rate rescaling, no rank transform. Built by
125,864 measured arrivals, mean 35.0 req/s, per-minute rate 21 to 52, rising
from the mid-20s over the first half hour to the high 40s over the second.
The class plan is in the same csv, one class per arrival, mix FIXED at m1. The
compressed trace (mix_dyn60_short_m123) moves rate and mix together and cannot
separate them; this one moves only the rate.
Arrival timing comes from the trace; prompts and outputs come from the three
application workloads, as everywhere else. Say 'arrival timing from a 60-minute
segment of the Azure code trace, replayed at its recorded rate'.
